title: Etch window profile
description: What Etch knows about one top-level window of Europa Universalis IV beyond its interface files: its selectors, exclusive groups, rules, views, links and the sources of its code-filled content (ADR 0006, docs/window-profiles.md).

formatVersion.description: The format version. A file with a newer version than Etch reads is skipped with a notice.

window.description: The top-level window's name, as its .gui file defines it.

checkedWith.description: The game's or the mod's version this file was checked with. Another version gives a notice; the profile still applies.

mod.description: For a mod's profile Etch ships: the mod it belongs to, matched by Workshop id, else by descriptor name.

selectors.description: What decides which view the game shows, keyed by id. null removes a lower layer's selector.

groups.description: Exclusive groups, keyed by id: the member of the selector's value shows, the others are hidden. null removes a lower layer's group.

rules.description: Rules, keyed by id: when every condition holds, the effects apply. Later rules win. null removes a lower layer's rule.

views.description: Named views, keyed by id: selector values and hand toggles. null removes a lower layer's view.

content.description: The source of each code-filled widget's text, keyed by widget path: a save path, a localisation key, the engine (only a live snapshot knows it) or generated text. null removes a lower layer's entry.

repeaters.description: List boxes the game's code fills, keyed by the list box's path: a template laid out once per child of a save collection, or count times without a save. null removes a lower layer's repeater.

links.description: Windows the game opens instead of this one, keyed by id: when the conditions hold, the preview offers to pin the linked window. null removes a lower layer's link.

defaultView.description: The view the preview opens on; the first view when no layer names one.

path.description: A widget path: names from the top-level window joined by /, with * and ? inside a name, ** for any number of levels and [n] for one of siblings that share a name.

kind.description: resolution: the preview's screen; data: a fact read from a save; ui: what the player clicked open; scripted: a mod's scripted interface, set by hand.

values.description: The values, keyed by id: a label, or for a resolution selector an object with the screen bounds (inclusive).

default.description: The value when nothing else sets it; the first value by default.

fact.description: For a data selector, the fact it reads. Its values are the fact's.

note.description: What decides the value in the game, such as a scripted potential; shown, never evaluated.

members.description: The member window of each selector value.

none.description: Whether a selector value may have no member, and then none shows.

when.description: The conditions, keyed by selector: one value, or any of several. Without it the rule always applies.

notCreated.description: Widgets the game does not create at all in this case.

position.description: Widgets the game's code moves, keyed by path: the positionType of the window's file it moves them to, or { positionType, axis } when they take only its x or its y.

frame.description: Sprite frames the game's code sets, keyed by path, counted from 1.

set.description: Selector values, keyed by selector; the resolution selector is left to the preview's screen.

toggles.description: Hand toggles, keyed by path: true shows the widget, false hides it.

save.description: A save path, such as provinces.{province}.base_tax (docs/window-profiles.md lists those Etch reads), or several to add up with transform sum.

loc.description: A localisation key of the playset.

engine.description: The engine works the value out (income, unrest, supply): only a live snapshot fills it.

generated.description: What the generated layer fills the text with; by default text, or the save value's format.

transform.description: sum adds up several save paths; localise shows the localisation of the save value (a culture, a religion, a tag).

format.description: How a save value is written: as it is (text), as a number, or as a number with %.

decimals.description: Decimals of a number or percentage; at most two, trailing zeros dropped, when not given.

save.description: A save path, such as provinces.{province}.base_tax (docs/window-profiles.md lists those Etch reads), or several to add up with transform sum.

loc.description: A localisation key of the playset.

engine.description: The engine works the value out (income, unrest, supply): only a live snapshot fills it.

generated.description: What the generated layer fills the text with; by default text, or the save value's format.

transform.description: sum adds up several save paths; localise shows the localisation of the save value (a culture, a religion, a tag).

format.description: How a save value is written: as it is (text), as a number, or as a number with %.

decimals.description: Decimals of a number or percentage; at most two, trailing zeros dropped, when not given.

template.description: The top-level definition of the playset each entry is made from.

from.description: The save collection the entries come from, such as provinces.{province}.buildings; a field reads one entry as entry, entry.key, entry.value or entry.<key>.

count.description: How many generated entries show without a save; 3 by default.

fields.description: The source of each text of an entry, keyed by its path in the template, the template's name first.

place.description: For a window the game's code puts entries in (not a list box): the first entry's start, the step to the next (the template's size by default) and, with columns, how many to a row; each a positionType of the window's file, which the game reads, or pixels.

oneOf.description: A positionType whose x is the number.
A positionType of the window's file.

when.description: The conditions, keyed by selector: one value, or any of several.

window.description: The top-level window the game opens instead.

label.description: The note the preview shows while the link holds.
